hints.title: Author Self-View Identification
hints.text: Retrieve authors who viewed their own authored articles, returning unique author identifiers sorted ascending.

hints.title: Equi-Column Equality Filter
hints.text: Filter rows where author identifier equals viewer identifier, then deduplicate and order the resulting ids.

hints.title: Article Views Query Blueprint
hints.text: select distinct author_id as id from Views where author_id = viewer_id order by id asc.

hints.title: Complete Implementation
hints.text:
```mysql
SELECT DISTINCT author_id AS id
FROM Views
WHERE author_id = viewer_id
ORDER BY id ASC;
```

complexity.notes: Row-level equality filtering followed by distinct sorting executes in linear-logarithmic time.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Omitting distinct keyword produces duplicate author rows when multiple self-views occur.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Distinct sort deduplicates keys while satisfying the required sort order.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of WHERE author_id = viewer_id and SELECT DISTINCT sorted by id.
